name: Rwanda landslide events with source-published/catalog coordinates

properties.houses_destroyed/damaged: houses destroyed; small roads, latrines and water wells damaged
properties.confidence: IFRC, Rwanda: Rubavu Landslide DREF Final Report, 2010, https://reliefweb.int/report/rwanda/rwanda-rubavu-landslide-dref-operation-n%C2%B0-mdrrw006-final-report
properties.source_3: IFRC report confirms the date, Rubavu sector and impacts; the NASA point is coarse (catalog uncertainty ~50 km) and not a slide scar centroid. Atlas national 2010 total differs; see report.

properties.infrastructure_affected: ~100 m highway washed away; road blocked
properties.source_2: eTurboNews, Key highways to tourist sites in Rwanda blocked by landslides, 7 May 2013, https://eturbonews.com/key-highways-tourist-sites-rwanda-blocked-landslides/
properties.notes: NASA GLC says 5 May; 7 May eTurboNews says “yesterday” (6 May). Coordinate is catalog-reported and accuracy was not stated; retained as a location cue, not an exact failure point.

properties.people_displaced: thousands reported homeless; episode total not harmonized
properties.houses_destroyed/damaged: >500 homes destroyed across affected districts; Gakenke/Ngororero 2,317 in FEWS NET episode total
properties.source_1 (title, publisher, date, URL): FEWS NET, Rwanda Key Message Update, May 2016, https://fews.net/east-africa/rwanda/key-message-update/may-2016
properties.source_3: FloodList, Rwanda — At Least 49 Killed in Floods and Landslides, 9 May 2016, https://floodlist.com/africa/rwanda-floods-landslides-gakenke-muhanga
properties.notes: FEWS NET reports 54 deaths for Gakenke+Ngororero and planned resettlement of ~28,000 people; contemporaneous news reports 49 nationally at an earlier update. These are not allocated to this point. NASA also lists a second Ngororero point for this same episode; one record per mapped district location is kept below.

properties.infrastructure_affected: cultivated land damaged; houses destroyed in combined episode
properties.source_1 (title, publisher, date, URL): FEWS NET, Rwanda Key Message Update, May 2016, https://fews.net/east-africa/rwanda/key-message-update/may-2016
properties.notes: Catalog point is broad and event-level impact totals are shared with Gakenke; not district-attributed. Same disaster episode as RWA-LS-0011.

properties.place_description: Crystal Mining Trading Company cassiterite concession
properties.source_1 (title, publisher, date, URL): Rwanda National Police, Police cautions public over illegal mining, 8 Dec 2016, https://police.gov.rw/media/news-detail/news/police-cautions-public-over-illegal-mining-2/
properties.notes: Rwanda National Police independently confirms date, Nduba sector and death. Catalog point passes Rwanda bounds and is consistent with Gasabo at district-scale, not a survey location.

properties.place_description: Sebeya River and other Rubavu areas
properties.infrastructure_affected: landslides reported in four sectors; flood damage
properties.source_1 (title, publisher, date, URL): HDX GLIDE Rwanda event table, 2018-03-03 record, https://data.humdata.org/dataset/100527e3-cd37-4248-8998-310d22325f5f/resource/306f434f-65b7-4f57-8690-f3e1023db32c/download/rwa_glide_events.csv
properties.notes: The HDX/GLIDE point is broad; coordinates are an inventory-reported point, not a mapped slide centroid. The GLIDE fatality field is 0; this means no fatalities recorded in this row, not proof none occurred.
